prompt: Which genes change when human pancreatic cancer cell lines are treated in culture with a direct KRAS inhibitor (such as MRTX1133, sotorasib or a pan-KRAS inhibitor) compared with vehicle at the same time point?
answers: Any direct KRAS inhibitor counts (G12C, G12D or pan-KRAS), at any dose or duration. Use parental, drug-sensitive human pancreatic cancer lines treated in culture, compared with vehicle-treated cells of the same line at the same time point.

GSE228010.rationale: Pan-KRAS inhibitor (KRASi) vs DMSO, 2 h, across 22 lines; six are PDAC lines with two replicates per arm.
GSE228010.samples_note: Only the six PDAC lines (AsPC1, Capan-1, HPAC, MIA PaCa-2, PANC-1, Panc 04.03); the lung, colorectal and kidney lines are out. case: cell type = "PDAC" and treatment = "KRASi"; control: cell type = "PDAC" and treatment = "DMSO"

GSE201412.rationale: MRTX1133 (KRAS G12D inhibitor) in vitro and in xenografts; in vitro AsPC1 has 24 h MRTX1133 vs 24 h DMSO, three replicates each.
GSE201412.samples_note: In vitro AsPC1 only, time-matched at 24 h. The 3 h MRTX1133 samples have no 3 h vehicle and are optional (not scored either way); xenografts and the lung, colon and gastric lines are out. case: source_name = "in-vitro cell line" and cell line = "AsPC1" and title = contains "_24h_133"; control: source_name = "in-vitro cell line" and cell line = "AsPC1" and title = contains "_24h_DMSO"

GSE273116.rationale: Pan-KRAS inhibitor MCB-294 vs vehicle in sotorasib-resistant MIA PaCa-2/SR, but only two of the three vehicle samples are in the NCBI count table (GSM8422090 is missing), so the control arm cannot reach three analysable samples.

GSE234449.rationale: MRTX1133 in SUIT2 cells, but at most two human samples per arm (the rest are mouse FC1242).

GSE249914.rationale: MCB-294 in mouse xenografts of H358 and AsPC-1: in vivo, not cells in culture.

GSE128385.rationale: BI-3406 is a SOS1::KRAS interaction inhibitor, not a direct KRAS inhibitor; MIA PaCa-2 xenografts, not culture.

GSE238198.rationale: Trametinib is a MEK1/2 inhibitor, not a KRAS inhibitor.

GSE213697.rationale: SHP2 and ERK inhibitors in MIA PaCa-2 xenografts; not a KRAS inhibitor.

GSE269985.rationale: MRTX1133-resistant vs parental lines, all untreated: no drug-vs-vehicle arm.

GSE71876.rationale: KRAS knockout clones (genetic), not a drug; mouse lines mixed in.

GSE100327.rationale: Inducible E47 expression in PDAC lines; no KRAS inhibitor.

GSE140490.rationale: DCLK1 inhibitor in PDAC lines; not a KRAS inhibitor.

GSE249726.rationale: Herbal formula Pien Tze Huang in AsPC1; not a KRAS inhibitor.

GSE240597.rationale: ISOX (HDAC6 inhibitor) in CD18/HPAF; not a KRAS inhibitor.

GSE103021.rationale: ARS-1620 in H358, LU65 and A549: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE130616.rationale: ARS-1620 in H358 spheroids: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE206867.rationale: Chronic Ras-targeted drugs in H358, one replicate each: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE240111.rationale: MRTX849 in H2030 and H2122: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE183516.rationale: ARS-1620 in H23 and H358 and inducible KRAS in AT2 cells: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE164326.rationale: KRAS G12C inhibitor resistance in lung adenocarcinoma models: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE255847.rationale: Adagrasib +/- BI-3406 in NCI-H2122 xenografts: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE250032.rationale: Adagrasib/BI-3406 in NCI-H2122 xenografts: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE225059.rationale: Adagrasib/BI-3406 in SW837 and NCI-H2122 xenografts: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

GSE225060.rationale: Adagrasib combinations, SW837 relapse: lung or colorectal cancer lines only; not pancreatic.

notes: Positives are subsets of multi-tissue series. Traps: xenografts, SOS1/MEK inhibitors, lung and colon lines, too few human samples per arm, and a vehicle arm missing from the count table (GSE273116).
